tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Supported chains, paid tool prices and payment details. Free.

tools.name: request_analysis
tools.description: Free: start a background sell-side analysis (kind 'report' or 'flows'). Full on-chain passes take ~4 min; the paid tool then returns the result instantly. Rate-limited.

tools.name: check_analysis
tools.description: Free: status of a requested analysis: ready, running or not_started.

tools.name: scan_token
tools.description: Free: who controls the contract (owner, guardian, minter, Safe threshold, fee/mint/pause powers) and the holder map with real float. Rate-limited.

tools.name: who_is_selling
tools.description: Paid ($0.10 USDC via x402): selling in the last N hours (default 24) across V2/V3/V4 pools, split by source: protocol, treasury, unstakers, real holders, arbitrage bots; net of arbitrage.

tools.name: sell_side_report
tools.description: Paid ($0.15 USDC via x402): full sell-side report. Risk assessment, contract control, real float, who is selling (24h), plus a markdown report.
